DRAYAGE Drayage to and from the port or local rail ramps, R&A vigilantly manages freight to ensure timely service and control costs. Read more WAREHOUSING / TRANSLOAD In our 250,000 square foot warehouse we store your goods safely. Transload to or from rail, container or truck. The R&A Difference R&A Trucking has been a trusted name in the transportation industry for nearly 50 years. Our complete services minimize logistic planning, making intermodal freight and cargo handling seamless, efficient and cost effective. Interested in working for us? Careers What We Offer Our SERVICES Transportation Services R&A Trucking is a full-service trucking company. With our company fleet and network of asset based and partnered carriers, we are ready to service all of your commercial trucking needs. Drayage Services R&A Trucking specializes in container drayage service for the Ports of Oakland, Richmond, San Francisco and Stockton as well intermodal service at the Oakland and Lathrop UP rail ramp & Oakland BNSF rail ramp to any United States destination. Logistics SF Bay Area logistic services. R&A boasts past and recent experience in logistical support and movement across all of the distribution network channels. Warehousing and Distribution R&A Trucking offers complete warehousing and distribution services. We support the industry with transload and JIT distribution. Whatever your need, from large metal coils to the smallest palletized accessories, R&A has the equipment and experience to do the job right. Container Lifting We pickup and deliver your storage container wherever and whenever you need it. These are mobile, self loading container trailer trucks known as Side-loaders. They are also referred to as side-lifters and sometimes as ‘self loading trailers.’ Learn About Our Container Lifting Services INDUSTRY SECTORS COVERAGE We specialize in Industrial Commodities in various forms from manufacturing, construction to wholesale industrial materials. Metals Steel, Aluminum, Copper / Brass Building Materials Glass, Lumber, Sheet Goods, Rebar, Panels, Palletized Building Materials Equipment Import / Export transload of machinery (Over dimensional) ABOUT R&A TRUCKING R&A Trucking Company, is a family owned business that has been operating out of Oakland, California for nearly 50 years. We are an end to end regional asset based carrier with warehousing and transload expertise that provide seamless last mile delivery. R&A also provides nationwide coverage through our network of partnered asset based carriers to move freight to or from any destination in North America. Read More What Our Clients Say Testimonials Great to work with this company. Very responsive and worked hard to help us with our logistical needs. Thanks R&A! Great to work with this company. Very responsive and worked hard to help us with our logistical needs. Thanks R&A! CuraFlo of BC Ltd., Very good place... awesome helpful people...I had a break down and had to find parts for the trailer....A gentleman "Scott" took his own time to drive me to a parts house so I could repair the trailer. A huge thank you goes out Kris Keller, I cannot recommend R and A Trucking Co more highly. They have helped me on several occasions to transport containers which are now going to a Wildlife Conservation Project in Niger. They were on time, very professional, able to move difficult equipment, responsive, in short they facilitated and supported my project immensely. Great drivers and nice people. I will be using them again in the future and hope that other do as well. Thanks! Stephen G, More than a Trucking Company: We specialize in Just in Time delivery, made possible by our onsite Warehouse and Transload operations. We are rail served 5 days a week by the Union Pacific Railroad (UP) and have a reciprocal switching agreement with the Burlington Northern Santa Fe Railroad. (BNSF) We have heavy lift capability by means of forklift or crane. We are EDI capable and ready to handle any freight that can be moved by Air, Rail or Sea. finding.detail: FMCSA USDOT 164773 identifies R & A TRUCKING COMPANY at 1050 77TH AVE, Oakland CA 94621-2539. The official contact page names R&A TRUCKING COMPANY at the same address, but canonical identity has only R&A Trucking and no verified full legal-name alias. The production verifier rejects that canonical subject difference, so this remains pending. The May 18, 2023 filing reports 20 power units and 20 drivers with status I and operation A; these are historical carrier figures, not current employees or proof of company closure. The site claims 250,000 square feet of warehouse space and partner-based national coverage; neither is audited company revenue. Other similar-name carriers are not aggregated.
